newsitem.title: USA: Titan Wheel says Q1 hurt by currencies.
newsitem.headline: Titan Wheel says Q1 hurt by currencies.

text.p: Titan Wheel International Inc said Thursday that quarterly results were hurt by European currency fluctuations and the divestiture of Titan's non-core businesses during 1996.
Net income for the first quarter of 1997 was $9.3 million, compared with $11.0 million for the first quarter of 1996, the company reported on Thursday.
The company also said sales for the first quarter of 1997 were $180.2 million, compared with $177.3 million in the prior year's first quarter.
Titan makes tire and wheel systems.
